steps.cap: A chip is built up in layers. For each layer the wafer goes around a loop of steps like this one, and each step uses its own chemical, gas or metal.
A fab runs many wafers at once, so every material is always in use. Deliveries keep each stock topped up.
If one material stops arriving, the fab works through its stock.
When the stock runs out, wafers pile up at that step, and the rest of the fab stands idle.
A new supplier’s resist goes through round after round of tests in the fab. Even one that passes the first time takes seven to 17 months to approve.
